snippet.title: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence - Official Gameplay Trailer | Black Voices in Gaming
snippet.description:
In the horror-platformer Ayasa: Shadows of Silence, you'll use light and shadow to navigate surreal, corrupted worlds. This strongly narrative-driven game is a story both creepy and philosophical, and the atmospheric art style has got to be seen to be believed. 

Play the demo and wishlist Ayasa: Shadows of Silence on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3146120/Ayasa_Shadows_of_Silence/
